chapter.v:
At the
time of the exodus of Israel from Egypt, when the descendants of Jacob left that foreign country,

the land
of Judah became the Lord's sanctuary, Israel his kingdom.

The Red
Sea saw them and ran away; the Jordan River retreated.

Mountains jumped
in fright like rams, hills were startled like lambs.

Red Sea—why
did you run away? Jordan River—why did you retreat?

Mountains—why did
you jump in fright? Hills—why were you startled like lambs?

Earth, tremble
in the presence of the Lord, tremble in the presence of the God of Jacob!

He is
the one who turned the rock into a pool of water; making water flow from the hard rock.
